bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Housing Measures No. 1) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-13.72.3) to keep schedule 4 of the [Treasury Laws Amendment (Housing Measures No. 1) Bill 2023](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr6972%22) unchanged. In parliamentary jargon, they voted that it "stand as printed". Schedule 4 "*contains amendments to Acts that are consequential to the HAFF [Housing Australia Future Fund] Bill and the functioning of the HAFF*" (read more in the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2223a/23bd059) ).
